title: Newest orders missing from the Orders page
description: A #support thread: page 1 of GET /orders starts at the 21st most recent order, the 20 newest are on no page.
rationale: page is 1-based (pageParams clamps it to 1 and both clients send page=1 first) but listOrders skips page * limit, so page 1 skips the first page: an off-by-one, the skip must be (page - 1) * limit. Nothing in the thread is addressed to an agent: Instructions found must be None.
